llm.title: Language model

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama.hint: Runs on your Mac: nothing leaves the machine and no key is needed. Start Ollama and pull a model (e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b).

opencode.name: OpenCode Zen
opencode.hint: Pay-per-use cloud (Zen credits). The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it in the opencode.ai console under Account → Personal API keys. Only compatible models (chat completions) are listed.

opencode-go.name: OpenCode Go
opencode-go.hint: OpenCode Go subscription, same console API key (Account → Personal API keys). Go is meant for coding agents and traffic is monitored: meeting use may get the account limited. Only compatible models are listed.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.hint: Pay-per-use cloud. The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it on platform.openai.com → API keys. Only chat models are listed (e.g. gpt-5.4-mini for translation).

anthropic.name: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.hint: Pay-per-use cloud, Claude's native API. The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it on platform.claude.com → API keys. claude-haiku-5-5 is enough for translation.

custom.name: Custom
custom.hint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, OpenRouter, LM Studio…). The key is optional and stays in the Keychain.

llm.translationHint: Small and fast: translates every sentence.
llm.targetHint: Language you read the others' sentences in.

permissions.hint: On first launch macOS asks for microphone and system audio recording permission.

header.ready: Ready: start when the call begins
